symptom: `alter page … set (DataSource: microflow M.F) on <gallery|datagrid2>` passes check, prints "Altered page", and the page unit is byte-identical; the same statement on a list view works
cause: SetWidgetDataSource ended with bsonnav.DSet(widget, "DataSource", …) and ignored its result; a CustomWidgets$CustomWidget has no top-level DataSource key (the source is Object.Properties[datasource].Value.DataSource), so DSet replaced nothing
insight: bsonnav.DSet replaces an existing key and returns false otherwise — an ignored DSet result is a silent-success generator, and grep for bare `bsonnav.DSet(` statements is a quick audit for the class. The READ side (widgetOwnDataSourceDoc, #1076) had already learned both locations; the write side had not, so the fix reuses that walk. The pluggable source is serialized with deps.SerializeCustomWidgetDataSource, the serializer CREATE/INSERT use for the same property, not serializeDataSourceBson; only microflow/nanoflow are written, and other kinds are refused with a pointer to REPLACE. check's dry run (probe.go) runs the real setter, so that refusal reaches check with no extra code
